parts.zh: 一项新研究发现，含添加糖的饮料可能有害健康
在该研究中，研究人员分析了超过8万名女性和3.7万名男性的信息
人们饮用的含添加糖饮料越多
这些饮料包括苏打水、能量饮料和运动饮料
即使在研究人员考虑了其他可能影响人们健康的因素后
科学家们表示，他们的研究结果支持限制含添加糖的饮料
W: 嗯，Susan说南非种族很多元
M: 南非不是几年前举办过足球世界杯吗？那他们一定很常踢足球吧？
M: 橄榄球？橄榄球是什么？
W: 橄榄球是一项两队对抗的运动

items.stem: What do we learn about the new study from the news report?

choices.text: It studied the effects of exercise on sleep.
choices.zh: 它研究了运动对睡眠的影响。

choices.text: Its participants came from various walks of life.
choices.zh: 它的参与者来自各行各业。

choices.text: Its findings confirmed those of previous studies.
choices.zh: 它的研究结果证实了先前研究的结论。

choices.text: It ran for as long as some thirty years.
choices.zh: 它持续了长达约三十年的时间。

items.stem: What is the scientists' recommendation?

choices.text: Eating more vegetables instead of meats.
choices.zh: 多吃蔬菜而不是肉类。

choices.text: Drinking water instead of beverages with added sugar.
choices.zh: 喝水而不是含添加糖的饮料。

choices.text: Consuming more energy drinks and sports drinks.
choices.zh: 摄入更多能量饮料和运动饮料。

choices.text: Forming the habit of exercising regularly.
choices.zh: 养成定期锻炼的习惯。

items.stem: What did German police say about a 64-year-old man?

choices.text: He asked them about his lost paintings.
choices.zh: 他向警方询问他丢失的画作。

choices.text: He knew the owner of two missing paintings.
choices.zh: 他知道两幅失踪画作的主人。

choices.text: He left his paintings at a highway rest stop.
choices.zh: 他把自己的画作落在了高速公路休息站。

choices.text: He found two 17th-century oil paintings.
choices.zh: 他发现了两幅17世纪的油画。

items.stem: What is the art expert's conclusion about the two framed paintings?

choices.text: They are imitations.
choices.zh: 它们是仿制品。

choices.text: They are originals.
choices.zh: 它们是真品。

choices.text: They were stolen by an Italian boy.
choices.zh: 它们被一个意大利男孩偷走了。

choices.text: They came from the same artist.
choices.zh: 它们出自同一位艺术家之手。

items.stem: What did the four-year-old girl attempt to do?

choices.text: Look after her grandfather.
choices.zh: 照顾她的祖父。

choices.text: Leave the remote cold region.
choices.zh: 离开偏远寒冷地区。

choices.text: Save her sick grandmother.
choices.zh: 救她生病的祖母。

choices.text: Flee from the threat of bears.
choices.zh: 逃离熊的威胁。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the girl's mother?

choices.text: She has to face a criminal charge.
choices.zh: 她不得不面临刑事指控。

choices.text: She was found lying motionless in the snow.
choices.zh: 她被发现一动不动地躺在雪地里。

choices.text: She searched for her daughter in freezing cold.
choices.zh: 她在严寒中寻找她的女儿。

choices.text: She works in childcare services.
choices.zh: 她在儿童看护服务机构工作。

items.stem: What happened to the little girl according to the news report?

choices.text: She was found in a forest after three days.
choices.zh: 她在三天后被发现在森林里。

choices.text: She lay totally unconscious for three days.
choices.zh: 她完全失去意识躺了三天。

choices.text: She suffered from the effects of severe cold.
choices.zh: 她遭受了严寒的影响。

choices.text: She was finally rescued by her relatives.
choices.zh: 她最终被她的亲属救出。

items.stem: What does the woman say about her new friend Susan?

choices.text: She shows a real passion for taking photos.
choices.zh: 她对摄影表现出真正的热情。

choices.text: She has just returned from her hometown.
choices.zh: 她刚从家乡回来。

choices.text: She comes from the city of Cape Town.
choices.zh: 她来自开普敦市。

choices.text: She has a truly amazing appearance.
choices.zh: 她有着真正惊人的外表。

items.stem: What does the woman say about Table Mountain?

choices.text: It is as famous as Cape Town.
choices.zh: 它和开普敦一样出名。

choices.text: It has a flat surface at the top.
choices.zh: 它的顶部有一个平坦的表面。

choices.text: It is green and free from pollution.
choices.zh: 它是绿色的且没有污染。

choices.text: It was named by European settlers.
choices.zh: 它是由欧洲殖民者命名的。

items.stem: What do we learn from the conversation about the woman's friend Susan?

choices.text: She has British ancestors.
choices.zh: 她有英国血统。

choices.text: She is of mixed blood.
choices.zh: 她是混血儿。

choices.text: She grew up in India.
choices.zh: 她在印度长大。

choices.text: She speaks several languages.
choices.zh: 她会说多种语言。

items.stem: What does the woman say about rugby in South Africa?

choices.text: It is an extremely violent sport.
choices.zh: 它是一项极其暴力的运动。

choices.text: It is becoming a national sport.
choices.zh: 它正在成为一项全国性运动。

choices.text: It is originated in New Zealand.
choices.zh: 它起源于新西兰。

choices.text: It is more popular than football.
choices.zh: 它比足球更受欢迎。

items.stem: What does the woman advise the man to do?

choices.text: Prepare a study guide.
choices.zh: 准备一份学习指南。

choices.text: Consult his advisors.
choices.zh: 咨询他的导师。

choices.text: Go over his notes regularly.
choices.zh: 定期复习他的笔记。

choices.text: Take stress-relief sessions.
choices.zh: 参加减压课程。

items.stem: What is the biggest problem the man has with his studies?

choices.text: His worksheets are terribly messy.
choices.zh: 他的作业纸非常凌乱。

choices.text: He finds the workload too heavy.
choices.zh: 他觉得学习负担太重。

choices.text: His study folder is badly disorganized.
choices.zh: 他的学习文件夹严重缺乏条理。

choices.text: He has difficulty taking notes quickly.
choices.zh: 他很难快速记笔记。

items.stem: What kind of learner does the woman say she is?

choices.text: A visual learner.
choices.zh: 视觉型学习者。

choices.text: An emotional learner.
choices.zh: 情感型学习者。

choices.text: An organized learner.
choices.zh: 条理型学习者。

choices.text: A logical learner.
choices.zh: 逻辑型学习者。

items.stem: What does the woman think the man can do with his notes?

choices.text: Arrange them using color and pictures.
choices.zh: 使用颜色和图片来整理它们。

choices.text: Restructure them in a logical way.
choices.zh: 以符合逻辑的方式重新组织它们。

choices.text: Commit them to memory after class.
choices.zh: 课后把它们记在脑子里。

choices.text: Organize them into a well-connected story.
choices.zh: 把它们组织成一个联系紧密的故事。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the golden rule?

choices.text: It is mainly based on a society's religion.
choices.zh: 它主要基于社会的宗教信仰。

choices.text: It is interpreted differently in different times.
choices.zh: 它在不同时代有不同的解释。

choices.text: It is a code of conduct based on laws and ethics.
choices.zh: 它是基于法律和伦理的行为准则。

choices.text: It is a moral principle to guide people's behavior.
choices.zh: 它是指导人们行为的道德原则。

items.stem: What is a notable criticism of the golden rule?

choices.text: It may lead to misunderstanding despite good intentions.
choices.zh: 尽管出于好意,它可能导致误解。

choices.text: It assumes that human beings are all good-natured.
choices.zh: 它假设人类都是善良的。

choices.text: It may sometimes produce undesirable outcomes.
choices.zh: 它有时可能产生不良后果。

choices.text: It fails to consider the complexity of human relationships.
choices.zh: 它未能考虑人际关系的复杂性。

items.stem: What does the example of someone breaking the law serve to show?

choices.text: The golden rule is often in conflict with certain laws and ethical principles.
choices.zh: 黄金法则常常与某些法律和伦理原则相冲突。

choices.text: The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.
choices.zh: 黄金法则有时必须让位于更重要的原则。

choices.text: Failure to follow the golden rule may lead to violation of laws and ethics.
choices.zh: 未能遵循黄金法则可能导致违反法律和伦理。

choices.text: Observing the golden rule is the first step to becoming a responsible citizen.
choices.zh: 遵守黄金法则是成为负责任公民的第一步。

items.stem: What do we learn from the current statistics about diversity in large corporations?

choices.text: Many of them find it rather difficult to manage.
choices.zh: 许多企业发现这相当难以管理。

choices.text: They have not seen as much diversity as desired.
choices.zh: 它们并未实现预期的多样性水平。

choices.text: Many of them have an increasingly diversified staff.
choices.zh: 许多企业的员工日益多元化。

choices.text: They have not quite grasped the concept of diversity.
choices.zh: 它们尚未完全理解多样性的概念。

items.stem: What is the newly published study focused on?

choices.text: Initiatives to achieve diversity in large corporations.
choices.zh: 大型企业实现多样性的举措。

choices.text: Advantages and disadvantages of a diversified team.
choices.zh: 多元化团队的优势和劣势。

choices.text: People's attitudes towards diversity at the workplace.
choices.zh: 人们对工作场所多样性的态度。

choices.text: Innovative ideas and solutions resulting from diversity.
choices.zh: 多样性带来的创新想法和解决方案。

items.stem: What do the findings of the new study show?

choices.text: People prefer to work with team members similar to themselves.
choices.zh: 人们更愿意与相似的团队成员共事。

choices.text: Employers attach great importance to their corporations' diversity.
choices.zh: 雇主非常重视其企业的多样性。

choices.text: Employers differ from employees in their perspectives on diversity.
choices.zh: 雇主与员工对多样性的看法存在差异。

choices.text: Doubts about the practicability of diversity are gradually disappearing.
choices.zh: 对多样性实用性的质疑正在逐渐消失。

items.stem: What is a major key to success in international business according to the passage?

choices.text: Choosing the best time for signing a business contract.
choices.zh: 选择签订商业合同的最佳时机。

choices.text: Changing one's form of communication from time to time.
choices.zh: 不时改变自己的沟通形式。

choices.text: Laying equal stress on written and spoken communication.
choices.zh: 同等重视书面沟通和口头沟通。

choices.text: Using different forms of communication appropriately.
choices.zh: 恰当地使用不同的沟通形式。

items.stem: What does the passage say about spoken word agreements in some Middle East countries?

choices.text: They are regarded as seriously binding.
choices.zh: 它们被视为具有严肃的约束力。

choices.text: They are seldom honored by business partners.
choices.zh: 它们很少被商业伙伴遵守。

choices.text: They are taken as memos of understanding.
choices.zh: 它们被视为谅解备忘录。

choices.text: They are to be confirmed in written form.
choices.zh: 它们需要以书面形式确认。

items.stem: What do we learn about the Western working culture?

choices.text: It has reached the highest level of evolution.
choices.zh: 它已达到最高的演进水平。

choices.text: It places a high value on written contracts.
choices.zh: 它高度重视书面合同。

choices.text: It regards written contracts as unalterable.
choices.zh: 它将书面合同视为不可更改的。

choices.text: It has seen a decline in verbal agreements.
choices.zh: 它的口头协议已经减少。

items.stem: How does a Japanese firm tend to view a written contract?

choices.text: Its details cannot be renegotiated.
choices.zh: 其细节不能重新谈判。

choices.text: It has to be carried out to the letter.
choices.zh: 它必须严格执行。

choices.text: It strengthens business partnerships.
choices.zh: 它加强了商业伙伴关系。

choices.text: Its terms may not be strictly binding.
choices.zh: 其条款可能不具有严格的约束力。
